source_text: In contrast, defenders invoke parental rights under frameworks like the "best interests" standard, positing that evolutionary and epidemiological data on benefits—such as a 60% reduction in HIV acquisition in heterosexual men per randomized trials—permit anticipatory consent, though these benefits are contested as overstated for low-risk populations in non-endemic areas. [50]
